Symptom Timeline and Clinical Evaluation
Cold symptoms typically improve within 7 to 10 days. When to Call a
Doctor: - Symptoms that worsen or fail to improve after 10 days. - Severe
or unusual symptoms, such as sudden high fever or severe chest pain. -
Symptoms in individuals at high risk for flu complications.
